verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs describe importing CSV, XLSX or XLS files for any object, with column-to-field mapping, duplicate detection and built-in error handling. Errors are highlighted in yellow and can be fixed directly in the UI before import, and related records such as deals linked to people or companies are resolved via unique fields like email or domain. This covers mapping and validation for contacts and deals, though each file must hold a single object type, so contacts and deals need separate imports. Missing for 10: an explicit guarantee or post-import report confirming no rows are silently dropped, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the import flow.
